authored_synthetic.definition: Content deliberately authored for this rehearsal and not derived from product, patient, practice, historical, protected or external-corpus data.

product_derived.definition: Any value copied, transformed, summarized or inferred from EMR4 product state, database state, logs, audit records or operational traffic.

patient_or_health_information.definition: Any identified, identifiable, pseudonymized or real patient, health, clinical, Medicare, contact, appointment or practice information.

australian_regional_processing.meaning: Provider-contractual ML inference processing within the country jurisdiction associated with australia-southeast1.
australian_regional_processing.admission_requirement: The exact model must be explicitly published as supporting ML processing in australia-southeast1 and the request must use only the locational endpoint with no fallback.
australian_regional_processing.current_evidence: The locational endpoint contract exists, but the exact Gemini 3.5 Flash model is not published as supported in australia-southeast1.

regional_storage.meaning: Data intentionally stored at rest in a selected Google Cloud location.
regional_storage.admission_requirement: Storage claims require a separately verified storage resource and location; inference endpoint selection alone is insufficient.
regional_storage.current_evidence: No storage resource, cache or persisted provider payload is authorised or created by this tranche.

global_endpoint.meaning: An endpoint without a region in the hostname that may route and process data globally.
global_endpoint.admission_requirement: Always reject; global endpoints provide no regional processing or data-residency guarantee.
global_endpoint.current_evidence: The global endpoint and every automatic fallback path are prohibited.

training.provider_contract: Google states that customer data is not used to train or fine-tune managed models without prior permission or instruction.
training.local_requirement: No permission or instruction to train or fine-tune is granted.

abuse_monitoring_retention.provider_contract: Google may log prompts for abuse monitoring for customers in scope unless an approved exception applies; some advanced features can have additional retention.
abuse_monitoring_retention.local_requirement: Use authored-synthetic content only, no grounding or tools, and make no zero-data-retention claim without separately verified eligibility.

request_response_logging.provider_contract: Request-response logging is disabled by default but can be enabled by project/model or endpoint configuration.
request_response_logging.local_requirement: A later preflight must verify disabled or absent configuration before content transmission.

in_memory_cache.provider_contract: Google states that published Gemini models cache inputs, outputs and derived customer data in memory by default, isolated at project level with a 24-hour TTL and not stored at rest; the setting can be disabled at project level.
in_memory_cache.local_requirement: Because Yuri authorised no cache creation, a later preflight must verify the exact project reports in-memory caching disabled. If that read requires broader permission or the setting is enabled, stop for Yuri without changing it.

independently_observed_evidence: Official model card lists the stable model ID and supported locations.
Official per-model residency matrix leaves Gemini 3.5 Flash unsupported for Australia.
The Australia regional service hostname exists independently of support for this model.
No credential, cloud project state or provider request was inspected.
provider_contractual_residency_evidence: Google states that locational endpoints bind ML processing to the associated broader multi-region or country jurisdiction.
Google states that global endpoints do not provide regional isolation or data-residency guarantees.
The exact per-model location matrix controls whether that general locational contract is available for a model.
